subject: Cloud vs Private: hosting handshake + legacy lift plan
messages:
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 14:04:00 -0700
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Megan Li <megan@dataforge.ai>, Aaron Chen <aaron@dataforge.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Subject: Post-call recap — deployment needs & next steps

Thanks again for the time today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum. High level we heard three driving requirements from DataForge: 

1) PHI + regulatory: need private network boundary (VPC peering or on-prem) for transactions that touch PHI.
2) Predictable throughput for inference (batch + real-time) during core business hours; current peak profile spikes to ~2500 concurrent req/s on legacy cluster.
3) Migration path: want to retire their self-hosted Triton cluster by Q4 and prefer a staged approach (pilot -> parallel run -> cutover).

Options we discussed (summary attached: redwood-hosting-options-v2.pdf):
- Hosted API: fastest onboarding, but not acceptable for PHI-bound traffic unless paired with our Private offering (segmented).
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools with optional VPC peering — strong fit for predictable throughput and simple cutover.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): required if you want full control of network + KMS/HSM integration for PHI workloads.

Open questions we need from your side to finalize recommendation:
- Confirm target dataset residency: will all inference traffic be PHI-classified or only a subset?
- Typical sequence lengths and p99 latency SLO target for real-time calls.
- Approximate daily token volume and concurrency by hour (sample CSV would help).

Immediate next steps I propose:
- Karthik will run a capacity/profiling session (we'll need sample load csv) to advise Dedicated sizing and autoscale windows.
- Aditya will share the security & compliance checklist for Private onboarding and outline KMS/HSM options.
- I’ll prepare a migration lift plan (scope spreadsheet attached: df-legacy-migration-scope.xlsx) and a dedicated quote for your review (DocuSign link pending).

Can you confirm whether you want us to size for a Dedicated pilot first (recommended for quickest validation) or proceed straight to Private VPC design? If you prefer a hybrid (Dedicated for production + Private for PHI), call that out and we’ll model costs.

Thanks — Olivia (Olga)

--
Olga Petrov

Subject: Re: Post-call recap — deployment needs & next steps

On Tue, Jun 23, 2026 at 2:04 PM Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the time today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum.

Thanks, Olga — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- PHI scope: roughly 60% of inference traffic will touch PHI records. We need either Private VPC with strict peering + customer KMS, or fully on-prem for the PHI partition. Hosted API alone is not acceptable.
- Our team would prefer Dedicated with VPC peering if Redwood can support customer-managed KMS and provide audit logs for token-level use. That gives us the operational simplicity and predictable throughput while keeping compliant boundaries.
- Legacy cluster: yes target decommission Q4 (goal: Nov 15 cutover). We can run a 4-week parallel validation window.

What we'd like next: a ballpark cost delta between Dedicated (with customer KMS + VPC peering) vs Private VPC deployment, plus a sample migration timeline that preserves the parallel run window. If you can include any known blockers for our stack (Triton + custom tokenizers), flag them.

We'll share a sample hourly concurrency CSV by EOD tomorrow.

— Megan
Director, Platform Engineering
DataForge, Inc.
megan@dataforge.ai | +1 617-555-0228
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Megan Li <megan@dataforge.ai>, Aaron Chen <aaron@dataforge.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — deployment needs & next steps

Thanks, Megan — appreciate the clarity. Quick replies + concrete plan attached.

1) Ballpark costs (high level):
- Dedicated (VPC peering + customer KMS): estimated monthly run-rate ~ $XXk–$YYk depending on reserve size and burst capacity. We’ll provide a detailed quote once we size with your CSV. (Draft quote attached: docusign-dedicated-quote-DF-4087.pdf)
- Private VPC (control plane in your VPC): higher upfront integration and operational run-rate; expect ~30–50% uplift vs Dedicated for equivalent capacity.

2) Migration timeline (proposed):
- Week 0: Kickoff + data exchange (you send hourly concurrency CSV + sample request traces) — target: this week (you said EOD tomorrow).
- Week 1: Capacity profiling & sizing (Karthik lead).
- Week 2: Security onboarding checklist (Aditya lead) + KMS/HSM scoping.
- Week 3–4: Dedicated pilot provisioning + smoke tests.
- Week 5–8: Parallel run with legacy cluster (validation tests, perf/regression evals).
- Week 9: Cutover decision window; target complete by Nov 15 as requested (we’ll iterate if you need earlier).

3) Blockers/risks we flagged:
- Custom Triton operators: may require model recompile or thin adapter layer — Karthik will validate during profiling.
- Tokenization differences: need canonical test prompts — please include an eval set.
- Audit log retention: if you need >1 year retention, that’s an add-on — we’ll call it out in the proposal.

Action items: 
- DataForge: share CSV and sample traces (Megan) — due: 2026-06-24 EOD.
- Redwood: Karthik to run profiling session (schedule link: https://cal.redwood.com/karthik/profiling) and share sizing by 2026-06-30.
- Redwood: Aditya to share private-onboarding checklist and KMS options by 2026-06-26.
- Olga: send updated migration scope (attached) and DocuSign for the Dedicated pilot quote.

If that looks right, I’ll set a 30-min kickoff for Friday to run through the CSV and agree on acceptance criteria for the parallel run.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

--
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0194
